title: Flash Mixer

introduction.definition: A flash (rapid) mixer disperses coagulant into raw water within seconds. A high-speed turbine impeller creates intense turbulence in a small chamber so the chemical reaches every part of the flow before it reacts, giving uniform coagulation for the flocculation stage that follows.
applications: Coagulant (alum, ferric, PACl) dispersion at water treatment plants
pH adjustment and polymer dispersion in industrial water and wastewater
introduction.summary: A flash mixer disperses coagulant through the raw water within seconds using a high-speed impeller, so the chemical reacts uniformly before flocculation.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Coagulation efficiency vs velocity gradient G — rises then levels off.

pressure.title: High velocity gradient, short time
pressure.description: Coagulants (alum, ferric salts, PACl) react within seconds, so they must be spread through the whole flow almost instantly. Flash mixers use high energy — velocity gradient G ≈ 300–1000 s⁻¹ — with short detention (≈ 10–60 s). Too little mixing wastes chemical; too long or too intense mixing is not useful at this stage.

foundation: Reinforced-concrete tank on prepared ground; watertightness test before backfill; allow for buoyancy when empty (groundwater).
alignment: Weirs and launders levelled to a few millimetres so overflow is even; drive/bridge centred and level.
piping: Inlet arranged to spread flow without short-circuiting; sludge lines with flushing points; overflow and drain to a safe place.
commissioning: Fill with clean water, check for leaks; run mechanisms empty and with water; start chemical dosing and tune by jar tests.

routine.task: Check impeller running, dose rate and vibration.

periodic.task: Inspect impeller for wear and deposits.

lubrication: Motor and drive bearings greased / oiled to maker schedule; gearbox oil changed by hours or oil analysis.

safety: Lock out before entering; guard the coupling.

script.narration: How the Flash Mixer works.

Coagulant is dosed close to the impeller.

video_tutorials.title: Flash Mixer — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Flash Mixer.
Check impeller running, dose rate and vibration.
Inspect impeller for wear and deposits.
Gearbox overhaul.
Watch for poor coagulation: floc forms badly downstream. Common cause: dose point far from impeller.
Watch for gearbox noise: vibration, heat. Common cause: low oil, worn bearings.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
